definitions.def: a thought structure or framework used to organize information
an act of breaking a rule or expectation
moving in a stiff, mechanical way like a machine

grammar_choice.en_template: The brain needs {{1:to create/creating}} a model of a constant pulse — a schema — so that we know {{2:when/what}} the musicians are not conforming to it.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 뇌는 일정한 박자의 모델 — 즉 스키마 — 를 만들어야 하며, 그래야 음악가가 그것을 따르지 않을 때를 우리가 알 수 있다.

grammar_choice.en_template: This is similar to variations of a melody: We need to have a mental representation of {{1:what/that}} the melody is in order {{2:to know/knowing}} — and appreciate — when the musician is taking liberties with it.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 이는 멜로디의 변주와 유사하다. 우리는 음악가가 멜로디를 자유롭게 변형할 때를 알고 — 그리고 음미하기 — 위해, 멜로디가 무엇인지에 대한 심적 표상을 가지고 있어야 한다.
explain: 전치사 of의 목적어 명사절, is의 보어가 빠진 불완전절 → 관계대명사 what.
in order to V — '~하기 위해' 목적의 to부정사.

grammar_choice.en_template: Metrical extraction, knowing what the pulse is and when we expect it {{1:to occur/occurring}}, {{2:is/are}} a crucial part of musical emotion.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 박자 추출, 즉 박자가 무엇이고 우리가 언제 그것이 일어날지 예상하는지를 아는 것은 음악적 감정의 결정적 부분이다.
explain: expect + 목적어 + to V — to부정사 목적격보어.

grammar_choice.en_template: Music communicates to us {{1:emotionally/emotional}} through systematic {{2:violations/violates}} of expectations.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 음악은 기대에 대한 체계적 위반을 통해 우리에게 감정적으로 소통한다.
explain: 전치사구의 핵이 되는 명사 필요 → violations(명사).

grammar_choice.en_template: These violations can occur in any domain — the domain of pitch, rhythm, tempo, and so on — but {{1:occur they must/they occur must}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 이러한 위반은 어떤 영역에서든 — 음높이, 리듬, 템포 등의 영역에서 — 일어날 수 있지만, 반드시 일어나야 한다.
explain: 강조를 위해 본동사 occur를 앞세운 도치 (= but they must occur).

grammar_choice.en_template: Music is organized sound, but the organization has {{1:to involve/involving}} some element of the unexpected {{2:or/and}} it is emotionally flat and robotic.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 음악은 조직화된 소리이지만, 그 조직화에는 예상치 못한 요소가 반드시 포함되어야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 감정적으로 밋밋하고 기계적이다.

grammar_choice.en_template: Too much organization may technically still be music, but it would be music {{1:that/what}} no one {{2:wants/want}} to listen to.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 지나친 조직화는 기술적으로는 여전히 음악일 수 있으나, 아무도 듣고 싶어 하지 않는 음악일 것이다.

jumble.answer: The brain needs to create a model of a constant pulse — a schema — so that we know when the musicians are not conforming to it.
This is similar to variations of a melody: We need to have a mental representation of what the melody is in order to know — and appreciate — when the musician is taking liberties with it.
Metrical extraction, knowing what the pulse is and when we expect it to occur, is a crucial part of musical emotion.
Music communicates to us emotionally through systematic violations of expectations.
These violations can occur in any domain — the domain of pitch, rhythm, tempo, and so on — but occur they must.
Music is organized sound, but the organization has to involve some element of the unexpected or it is emotionally flat and robotic.
Too much organization may technically still be music, but it would be music that no one wants to listen to.
